scope: Read-only source/config inspection and temporary in-memory geometry calculations. No production scripts, meshes, URDF, config or source 3MF modified. This JSON is the only persistent output of this subtask.

coordinate_convention.units: nominal CAD millimeters before 1.01 print scale
coordinate_convention.adapter_axes: Same axes as original assembled CAD; +Y toward hand; production datum CAD [0,-12.6,0]

parts.name: Revo3展示底座支架
parts.role: Upper hand sleeve with existing 10 mm cable slot, hand-side holes and upper shoulder.

parts.name: 转接件 嵌螺母版本（用于3D打印塑料件）
parts.role: Lower wrist-side flange/spigot, shoulder, anti-rotation geometry and captive-nut features. Leave unchanged for slot relocation.

parts.name: 目标孔_15x6.2
parts.role: Subtractive 15 mm wide by 6.2 mm high cutter expanding the already-present 10 mm slot.

existing_slot.measurement: Bounds extracted from actual triangle vertices on the two slot walls with normals parallel to X and coordinates X=+/-5.
existing_slot.important: Moving only negative part 3 leaves the original 10 mm +Z opening in part 1. It must be restored before making a single right-side opening.

recommended_local_edit.left: Keep original part 1, subtract part 3 at +Z, union with unchanged part 2.
recommended_local_edit.right: Union part 1 with an exact rectangular fill of its original 10 mm slot; subtract part 3 after rigid Y-axis 180 degree transformation diag(-1,1,-1); union with unchanged part 2.
recommended_local_edit.transform_applies_to: Only the negative cutter for the right slot. Do not rotate any positive component or assembled adapter.
recommended_local_edit.safe_edit_region: Localized old/new slot neighborhoods: |X|<=7.5 mm, Y approximately [-1.03,5.17] mm, |Z| approximately [20,27.925] mm. Do not transform the full upper sleeve.
preserved_geometry: Entire part 2 (Y<=-1.1): wrist shoulder, spigot, anti-rotation feature, captive nuts and wrist holes.
Upper hand rim at Y=22.9 and all hand-side screw holes near Y=17.9/18.9.
Both wrist transforms, both hand transforms, overall adapter coordinate system.
recommended_local_edit.numerical_note: read_parts snaps shared seam Y=-1.1 by at most 6e-7 mm. The memory test used exact measured box bounds; no new overlap epsilon was necessary.

in_memory_validation.method: trimesh boolean union/difference with manifold engine; never exported test meshes.
in_memory_validation.interpretation: Localized fill-and-recut produces one closed positive solid per side. Small left/right volume difference is consistent with slightly unequal opposite tessellated wall geometry; does not demonstrate fit or strength.

upper_only_rotation_analysis.effect: Swaps +X/-X and +Z/-Z sides, preserves Y heights and +/-Y face normals; rotates all other normals by the same proper rotation, so face winding need not reverse.
upper_only_rotation_analysis.hand_holes: The nominal centered +/-X hole pair remains an X-directed pair and +/-Z remains Z-directed, with Y heights preserved; opposite counterbores/chamfers/features exchange sides.
upper_only_rotation_analysis.shoulder: The nominal central symmetric rim/shoulder remains in its Y plane, but actual tessellation is not exactly invariant.
upper_only_rotation_analysis.wrist_key: If and only if this is applied exclusively to source part 1, source part 2 and its wrist-side keyed features do not rotate. Rotating the whole combined mesh would rotate those features and is prohibited by the user's instruction.
upper_only_rotation_analysis.difference_support: Besides the dominant slot-sized block, tiny differences span the sleeve and rim; a full-upper rotation is therefore not literally a slot-only edit.
upper_only_rotation_analysis.recommendation: Do not rotate the full upper piece when the stated change is only cable-slot handedness. Use localized closure and recut.

limitations: The comparison is geometric; it does not verify printed tolerances, hole fit, fastener access, cable bend radius or structural strength.
Any newly designed wrist anti-rotation mouth must remain registered to the wrist coordinate frame and excluded from slot transformations.
Retaining current transforms preserves current orientation assumptions; it does not upgrade the existing prototype mount to measured calibration.
